name: Naerotiv
desc:
Naerotiv is a Kyrsan NPC.

He is located to the right of the entrance to the [second floor](location:new_kyrsa) of the [Second Layer](location:second_layer). He has a brother named [Frosviernr Joraelnaero](entity:frosviernr_joraelnaero) further into the city, who made and gives the player the Kyrswynter. Interacting with Naerotiv is needed as a step to obtain the aforementioned Kyrswynter.

Naerotiv tells you how the [City of New Kyrsa](location:new_kyrsa) came to be today, about how the Kyrsans once lived, and where they built a shrine over [Ethiron's Scion](entity:scion_of_ethiron) to ensure it remains asleep, which eventually led to the City being developed. He mentions of how they used a ritual, namely the The Ninefold Blessings of Marrow, to ensure the Scion remains asleep. When the Ninth blessing was left incomplete as a result of the Kyrsans attempting to harness the puppet's power.

Once the Scion was awoken, it released a sound, a Tone of Song, which deafened everyone around the City. A sound that turned all of the Kyrsans nearby into puppets, just like itself.

Naerotiv urges the Pathfinder to set his kind free by completing the ritual and sealing the [Scion of Ethiron](entity:scion_of_ethiron) away for good. If not, the Gale present in the [Second Layer](location:second_layer) would seep through and eventually engulf the Surface as well.
additional_info:
-   He is located right next to where a possible Medallion chest would spawn.
-   [Alpha](entity:alpha) mentions of how [The Ignition Union](faction:the_ignition_union) is trying to use the Gale to harness infinite power as well, same as The Scholars.
    -   But that idea was the very thing that led to the Kyrsan's downfall.
-   His name, "Naerotiv" is a play on the word "narrative".
